articles.title_en: A structural microsimulation model for demand-side cost-sharing in healthcare
articles.title_cn: 医疗保健需求侧费用分担的结构性微观模拟模型
articles.abstract_en: Demand-side cost-sharing reduces moral hazard in healthcare but increases exposure to out-of-pocket expenditure. We introduce a structural microsimulation model to evaluate both total and out-of-pocket expenditure for different cost-sharing schemes. We use a Bayesian mixture model to capture the healthcare expenditure distributions across different age–gender categories. We estimate the model using Dutch data and simulate outcomes for a number of policies. The model suggests that for a deductible of 300 euros shifting the starting point of the deductible away from zero to 400 euros leads to an average 4% reduction in healthcare expenditure and 47% lower out-of-pocket payments.
articles.abstract_cn: 需求侧费用分担减少了医疗保健中的道德风险，但增加了自付费用的暴露。我们引入了一个结构性微观模拟模型，以评估不同费用分担方案下的总支出和自付支出。我们使用贝叶斯混合模型来捕捉不同年龄-性别类别的医疗保健支出分布。我们使用荷兰数据估计模型，并模拟多种政策的结果。模型表明，对于300欧元的免赔额，将免赔额的起点从零移至400欧元，会导致医疗保健支出平均减少4%%，自付费用降低47%%。

articles.title_en: Adverse selection and network design under regulated plan prices: Evidence from Medicaid
articles.title_cn: 受监管计划价格下的逆向选择与网络设计：来自医疗补助计划的证据
articles.abstract_en: Health plans for the poor increasingly limit access to specialty hospitals. We investigate the role of adverse selection in generating this equilibrium among private plans in Medicaid. Studying a network change, we find that covering a top cancer hospital causes severe adverse selection, increasing demand for a plan by 50% among enrollees with cancer versus no impact for others. Medicaid’s fixed insurer payments make offsetting this selection, and the contract distortions it induces, challenging, requiring either infeasibly high payment rates or near-perfect risk adjustment. By contrast, a small explicit bonus for covering the hospital is sufficient to make coverage profitable.
articles.abstract_cn: 面向贫困人群的健康计划日益限制对专科医院的准入。我们研究了逆向选择在医疗补助计划中私人计划之间形成这种均衡的作用。通过研究一次网络变更，我们发现覆盖一家顶级癌症医院会导致严重的逆向选择，使癌症参保者对该计划的需求增加50%，而对其他人群没有影响。医疗补助计划的固定保险公司支付使得抵消这种选择及其引发的合同扭曲具有挑战性，需要要么不可行的高支付率，要么近乎完美的风险调整。相比之下，为覆盖该医院提供一笔小额明确奖金就足以使覆盖变得有利可图。

articles.title_en: The education-health gradient: Revisiting the role of socio-emotional skills
articles.title_cn: 教育-健康梯度：重新审视社会情感技能的作用
articles.abstract_en: Is the education-health gradient inflated because both education and health are associated with unobserved socio-emotional skills? We find that the gradient in health behaviors and outcomes is reduced by about 15 to 50% from accounting for fine-grained personality facets and up to another 50% from Locus of Control. Traditional aggregated Big-Five scales, however, have a much smaller contribution to the gradient. We use sibling-fixed effects to net out the contribution from genes and shared childhood environment, decomposing the gradient into its components with an order-invariant method. We rely on a large survey (N = 28,261) linked to high-quality Danish administrative registers with information on parental background and objectively measured diagnoses and care use. Accounting for Locus of Control yields the strongest gradient reduction in self-rated health status and objective diagnoses (30%–50%), and in health behaviors the most important factor is Extraversion, a skill that has been shown to be malleable in interventions.
articles.abstract_cn: 教育-健康梯度是否因为教育和健康都与未观察到的社会情感技能相关而被高估？我们发现，在考虑了细粒度的人格侧面后，健康行为和结果中的梯度减少了约15至50%，而控制点又进一步减少了高达50%。然而，传统的聚合大五人格量表对梯度的贡献要小得多。我们使用兄弟姐妹固定效应来剔除基因和共享童年环境的贡献，并用一种顺序不变的方法将梯度分解为其组成部分。我们依赖于一项大型调查（N = 28,261），该调查与高质量的丹麦行政登记数据相关联，包含父母背景以及客观测量的诊断和护理使用信息。考虑控制点后，自评健康状况和客观诊断中的梯度减少最为显著（30%–50%），而在健康行为方面，最重要的因素是外向性，这是一种已被证明在干预中可塑的技能。

articles.title_en: Getting the right tail right: Modeling tails of health expenditure distributions
articles.title_cn: 正确估计右尾：健康支出分布尾部的建模
articles.abstract_en: Health expenditure data almost always include extreme values, implying that the underlying distribution has heavy tails. This may result in infinite variances as well as higher-order moments and bias the commonly used least squares methods. To accommodate extreme values, we propose an estimation method that recovers the right tail of health expenditure distributions. It extends the popular two-part model to develop a novel three-part model. We apply the proposed method to claims data from one of the biggest German private health insurers. Our findings show that the estimated age gradient in health care spending differs substantially from the standard least squares method.
articles.abstract_cn: 健康支出数据几乎总是包含极端值，这意味着潜在分布具有重尾。这可能导致方差以及高阶矩无限大，并使常用的最小二乘法产生偏差。为了适应极端值，我们提出了一种估计方法，该方法能够恢复健康支出分布的右尾。它将流行的两部分模型扩展为一种新颖的三部分模型。我们将所提出的方法应用于德国最大的私人健康保险公司之一的索赔数据。我们的研究结果表明，医疗支出中估计的年龄梯度与标准最小二乘法存在显著差异。

articles.title_en: The effects of alcohol sale bans on children: The case of Russia
articles.title_cn: 酒精销售禁令对儿童的影响：以俄罗斯为例
articles.abstract_en: Alcohol control policies are implemented to reduce alcoholism and related harms around the globe. This work examines the effects of a policy that restricted when alcohol could be purchased on child outcomes in Russia. To identify causal impacts, I exploit variation in the timing and severity of the restriction, which was implemented in Russian states between 2005 and 2010. Utilizing household survey data and a difference-in-differences estimation approach, I find that the policy has improved children’s physical health, with younger children being more affected, and additionally has decreased a variety of risky behavior indicators. Potential mechanisms for these effects include alcohol consumption, parental employment, household income, family stability, and time use. This work demonstrates that policies controlling parental substance access can have important effects on child health.
articles.abstract_cn: 酒精控制政策在全球范围内被实施以减少酗酒及相关危害。本研究考察了一项限制酒精购买时间的政策对俄罗斯儿童结局的影响。为识别因果效应，我利用了该限制在俄罗斯各州于2005年至2010年间实施的时间和严重程度的差异。利用家庭调查数据和双重差分估计方法，我发现该政策改善了儿童的身体健康，其中年龄较小的儿童受影响更大，并且还减少了多种风险行为指标。这些效应的潜在机制包括酒精消费、父母就业、家庭收入、家庭稳定性和时间使用。本研究证明，控制父母物质获取的政策可能对儿童健康产生重要影响。

articles.title_en: Nudging the nudger: Performance feedback and organ donor registrations
articles.title_cn: 助推助推者：绩效反馈与器官捐献者登记
articles.abstract_en: In a randomized controlled trial conducted in three waves over 2.5 years and involving nearly 700 customer-service representatives (CSRs) from a Canadian government service agency, we studied how providing CSRs with repeated performance feedback, with or without peer comparison, affected their subsequent organ donor registration rates. The feedback resulted in a 25 % increase in daily signups compared to otherwise equivalent encouragements and reminders. Adding benchmark information about peer performance did not amplify or diminish this effect. We observed increased registration rates for both high and low performers. A post-intervention survey indicates that CSRs in all conditions found the information included in the treatments helpful and motivating, and that signing up organ donors makes their job more meaningful. We also found suggestive evidence that performance feedback with benchmark information was the most motivating and created the least pressure to perform.
articles.abstract_cn: 在一项随机对照试验中，我们在2.5年内分三轮进行，涉及加拿大某政府服务机构近700名客户服务代表（CSR），研究了向CSR提供重复绩效反馈（无论是否包含同行比较）如何影响其后续的器官捐献者登记率。与同等鼓励和提醒相比，反馈使每日登记人数增加了25%。添加关于同行绩效的基准信息并未增强或减弱这一效应。我们观察到高绩效者和低绩效者的登记率均有所提高。干预后调查显示，所有条件下的CSR都认为治疗中包含的信息有帮助且具有激励作用，并且登记器官捐献者使他们的工作更有意义。我们还发现了提示性证据，表明带有基准信息的绩效反馈最具激励性，且产生的表现压力最小。

articles.title_en: Housing wealth, fertility and children's health in China: A regression discontinuity design
articles.title_cn: 中国住房财富、生育率与儿童健康：一项断点回归设计
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the influence of housing wealth on fertility outcomes through a regression discontinuity design based on a 2006 Chinese housing-market policy. Our analysis reveals that the positive impact of this policy on housing wealth significantly enhances the likelihood of fertility by 7.3 %. Our result implies that a 1 % increase in housing wealth can raise the fertility rate by 0.18 %. Furthermore, we observe that children born subsequent to the positive housing wealth shock exhibit improved health, not only at birth but also over the long term. Lastly, we present suggestive evidence suggesting that both parental pre-birth time allocation and parental health may help explain the documented positive effects of housing wealth on fertility rates.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过基于2006年中国住房市场政策的断点回归设计，考察了住房财富对生育结果的影响。我们的分析显示，该政策对住房财富的积极影响显著提高了生育可能性，增幅为7.3%。我们的结果表明，住房财富每增加1%，生育率可提高0.18%。此外，我们观察到，在住房财富正向冲击后出生的儿童，不仅在出生时，而且在长期内都表现出更好的健康状况。最后，我们提出的提示性证据表明，父母生育前的时间分配和父母健康可能有助于解释所记录的住房财富对生育率的积极影响。

articles.title_en: Financial incentives for sanitation take-up: A randomized control trial in rural Vietnam
articles.title_cn: 卫生设施普及的财政激励：越南农村的一项随机对照试验
articles.abstract_en: This study assesses the impact of financial incentives on hygienic latrine ownership by poor/near-poor households in Vietnam. Rural communes were randomly assigned to a control group and three treatment arm groups: (T1) a rebate for households that installed a hygienic latrine; (T2) a financial reward for commune governments if the proportion of hygienic latrines in their commune increased by 30 percentage points; (T3) both a household rebate and a commune reward. We find a strong and positive effect from the household rebate (treatment arms 1 and 3) but an insignificant effect from the commune reward (treatment arm 2) on household ownership of a septic tank latrine. Our analysis provides suggestive evidence that microcredit is a channel through which a rebate encourages the installation of septic tank latrines. We also find that treatment arm 3 increases people's knowledge regarding sanitation and the availability of water and soap for handwashing within households.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究评估了财政激励对越南贫困/近贫困家庭拥有卫生厕所的影响。农村公社被随机分配到对照组和三个处理组：（T1）为安装卫生厕所的家庭提供回扣；（T2）如果公社内卫生厕所比例提高30个百分点，则对公社政府给予财政奖励；（T3）同时提供家庭回扣和公社奖励。我们发现，家庭回扣（处理组1和3）对家庭拥有化粪池厕所具有强烈且积极的影响，而公社奖励（处理组2）的影响不显著。我们的分析提供了暗示性证据，表明小额信贷是回扣鼓励安装化粪池厕所的一个渠道。我们还发现，处理组3提高了人们对卫生设施以及家庭内洗手用水和肥皂可用性的认识。

articles.title_en: Investigating the complexity of naloxone distribution: Which policies matter for pharmacies and potential recipients
articles.title_cn: 调查纳洛酮分发的复杂性：哪些政策对药房和潜在接受者重要
articles.abstract_en: Despite efforts to expand naloxone access, opioid-related overdoses remain a significant contributor to mortality. We study state efforts to expand naloxone distribution through pharmacies by reducing the non-monetary costs to prescribers, dispensers, and/or potential recipients of naloxone. We find that laws that only address liability costs have small and insignificant effects on the volume of naloxone dispensed through pharmacies. In contrast, we estimate large effects of laws removing the need for patients to obtain prescriptions from traditional prescribers (e.g., primary care physicians): laws authorizing non-patient-specific prescription distribution and laws granting pharmacists prescriptive authority. We test whether areas designated as primary care shortage areas—where it would be costlier to obtain a prescription—were disproportionately impacted. Shortage areas experienced sharper growth in pharmacy naloxone dispensing in states adopting prescriptive authority policies. These gains were primarily due to those facing low out-of-pocket costs, suggesting that price barriers also must be addressed to increase naloxone purchases.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管努力扩大纳洛酮的可及性，阿片类药物相关的过量死亡仍然是死亡率的重要贡献因素。我们研究了各州通过降低处方者、配药者和/或潜在纳洛酮接受者的非货币成本来扩大药房纳洛酮分发的努力。我们发现，仅涉及责任成本的法律对通过药房分发的纳洛酮数量影响较小且不显著。相比之下，我们估计取消患者需要从传统处方者（如初级保健医生）获得处方要求的法律效果显著：授权非特定患者处方分发的法律和授予药剂师处方权的法律。我们测试了被指定为初级保健短缺地区（在这些地区获得处方成本更高）是否受到不成比例的影响。在采用处方权政策的州，短缺地区的药房纳洛酮分发增长更为迅速。这些增长主要归因于那些自付费用较低的人，这表明价格障碍也必须得到解决以增加纳洛酮的购买。

articles.title_en: Health insurance, agricultural production and investments
articles.title_cn: 健康保险、农业生产与投资
articles.abstract_en: We study the effects of health insurance coverage on agricultural production decisions, examining the causal relationships by exploiting a health care reform and providing a theoretical framework to elucidate underlying mechanisms. We find that the reform led to long-run increases in total cultivation investments and output, accompanied by a shift in households’ cultivation portfolio towards riskier crops. We explain these findings using a model of agricultural investment, highlighting the important roles of health insurance in mitigating background medical expenditure risks and enhancing health. We also find that the reform improved households’ financial well-being through reduced debts and defaults on loans.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了健康保险覆盖对农业生产决策的影响，通过利用医疗改革来检验因果关系，并提供一个理论框架以阐明潜在机制。我们发现，改革导致了总耕作投资和产出的长期增长，同时伴随着家庭耕作组合向风险更高作物的转变。我们使用一个农业投资模型来解释这些发现，强调了健康保险在减轻背景医疗支出风险和增强健康方面的重要作用。我们还发现，改革通过减少债务和贷款违约改善了家庭的财务状况。

articles.title_en: Hospital competition when patients learn through experience
articles.title_cn: 患者通过经验学习时的医院竞争
articles.abstract_en: We study competing hospitals’ incentives for quality provision in a dynamic setting where healthcare is an experience good. In our model, the utility a patient derives from choosing a particular provider depends on a subjective component specific to the match between the patient and the provider, which can only be learned through experience. We find that the experience-good nature of healthcare can either reinforce or dampen the demand responsiveness to quality and the hospitals’ incentives for quality provision, depending on two key factors: the shape of the distribution of match-specific utilities and the cost relationship between quality provision and treatment volume. We establish conditions under which ignoring the experience dimension of healthcare leads to inaccurate assessments of the competitiveness of hospital markets.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在动态环境中，医院提供质量的激励，其中医疗保健是一种经验品。在我们的模型中，患者选择特定提供者所获得的效用取决于患者与提供者之间匹配特有的主观成分，这种成分只能通过经验来学习。我们发现，医疗保健的经验品性质可以增强或减弱需求对质量的响应性以及医院提供质量的激励，这取决于两个关键因素：匹配特有效用的分布形状以及质量提供与治疗量之间的成本关系。我们建立了条件，在这些条件下，忽略医疗保健的经验维度会导致对医院市场竞争力的不准确评估。

articles.title_en: Hospital behavior over the private equity life cycle
articles.title_cn: 私募股权生命周期中的医院行为
articles.abstract_en: Private equity is an increasing presence in US healthcare, with unclear consequences. Leveraging unique data sources and difference-in-differences designs, we examine the largest private equity hospital takeover in history. The affected hospital chain sharply shifts its advertising strategy and pursues joint ventures with ambulatory surgery centers. Inpatient throughput is increased by allowing more patient transfers, and crucially, capturing more patients through the emergency department. The hospitals also manage shorter, less treatment-intensive stays for admitted patients. Outpatient surgical care volume declines, but remaining cases focus on higher complexity procedures. Importantly, behavior changes persist even after private equity divests.
articles.abstract_cn: 私募股权在美国医疗保健领域的存在日益增加，但其后果尚不明确。利用独特的数据来源和双重差分设计，我们研究了历史上最大规模的私募股权收购医院案。受影响的医院连锁显著调整了其广告策略，并与门诊手术中心建立合资企业。通过允许更多患者转院，以及关键的是，通过急诊科捕获更多患者，住院患者吞吐量得以增加。医院还对住院患者实施更短、治疗强度更低的住院时间。门诊手术量下降，但剩余病例集中于更复杂的手术。重要的是，即使在私募股权撤资后，行为变化仍然持续。
